issues.on_page: Water 75,745.52 (line 48, under Business-Type Activities, General Fund column)
issues.issue: Water is printed under Business-Type Activities but only in the General Fund column; recording it as governmental is defensible and is already in decision_needed, but it may belong to business-type (detail[12] likewise)

the General Fund also carries the water operation (75,745.52 spending) and has no other receipt line that could hold water charges, so this line likely includes water receipts; label prints 'Other' and there is no breakdown, so other is defensible
